source_doc_refs.consumption_role: Defines mandatory ledger-gated redesigned preregistration after the zero-event corrected-basis preflight.
Defines A-share minimal_data_burst as research / paper only and requires independent burst-lane evidence.
Defines CSI1000 as provisional primary benchmark and CSI300 as mandatory diagnostic context for A-share burst evidence.
Singleton ledger that records the spent corrected-basis preflight and gates this redesigned planned test.
Evidence that the steady Tier1 universe has zero valid all-pass burst events and must not be outcome-run.
Routes the next A-share burst alpha-validation step to a ledger-gated redesign rather than a corrected 5d rerun.

hypothesis_registration.hypothesis_text: A redesigned A-share minimal-data burst test should evaluate the frozen full EGS candidate surface, not the steady Tier1 watchlist. A frozen EOD trigger requiring relative strength, volume expansion, and breakout quality may produce enough valid events and positive 5-day cost-adjusted excess return versus same-anchor CSI1000 to justify continuing research. The result can only decide whether to continue research; it cannot promote production, live observation, or ship-gate evidence.
hypothesis_registration.data_window_at_registration: Frozen historical monthly full EGS intermediate candidate surfaces from 20240131 through 20251231 under result/a_short/backtest/generated/_intermediate/egs_full_{YYYYMMDD}.csv. The generated top-15 candidates.csv files are not the source universe for this redesigned test.
hypothesis_registration.evidence_available_at_registration: The corrected-basis steady Tier1 preregistration failed a pre-outcome event-count preflight with valid_signal_events = 0. The same preflight found a few all-pass burst rows outside the steady Tier1 hard-filter universe, which is sufficient to justify a ledger-gated redesigned preregistration but not sufficient to claim alpha.

eligibility_rule: Use only rows already present in the frozen full EGS intermediate files; do not regenerate candidate universes inside this test.
Use both Tier1 and Tier2 rows; do not require the steady-lane Tier1 watchlist, entry_flag, chasing_high veto, or overheat veto as eligibility filters.
Require pct_5d, pct_20d, market_med_20d, is_breakout, close, high_20d, avg_amount_5d, and avg_amount_20d to be present.
exclusion_rule: Exclude rows with missing ts_code, trade date, close, pct_5d, pct_20d, market_med_20d, avg_amount_5d, avg_amount_20d, is_breakout, or tier.
Exclude rows with has_crash_veto == true or is_lock == true where columns are present.
Exclude rows whose T+1 entry is unbuyable due to limit-up; record the unbuyable count and rate.
Do not add sector, theme, manual catalyst, capital-flow, or full-data burst fields in this minimal-data test.

data_window.cohort_frequency: monthly frozen full EGS intermediate candidate surfaces only
data_window.outcome_data_ref: existing A-share EOD forward-return surface used by runners/backtest_rank.py; no new provider fetch is authorized by this artifact
lookahead_prevention_notes: Use each cohort's frozen full EGS intermediate file as the decision snapshot.
Do not rerun A-EGS/egs_main.py or regenerate cohorts inside this test.
Use T+1 entry and T+5 exit prices after the as_of date only after a reviewed preflight confirms sufficient events.
Do not let later 2026 live-style outputs affect the 2024-2025 promotion-relevant statistic.

hard_filters: list_status must equal L where present.
has_crash_veto and is_lock must be false where present.
Do not filter by steady-lane Tier1, entry_flag, chasing_high, or overheat_flag before the trigger is evaluated.
signal_definition: All three positive signal families must pass; no alternate thresholds or fallback families are allowed in this test.
chasing_high and overheat_flag are recorded as risk diagnostics, not eligibility filters, because the failed steady-watchlist preflight showed burst candidates can sit in the steady-vetoed area.
trigger_rule.portfolio_construction_rule: Equal-weight all passing rows in each monthly cohort; if more than 20 rows pass, take the top 20 by pct_5d descending, then amount expansion ratio descending, then final_score descending, with ts_code as deterministic tie-breaker. Empty cohorts are recorded as zero-signal cohorts and are not backfilled.

entry_exit_rule.entry_rule: Enter at T+1 open using qfq-adjusted open, matching runners/backtest_rank.py T+1 semantics.
entry_exit_rule.exit_rule: Exit at T+5 close using qfq-adjusted close; no stop, profit-take, re-entry, or holding-period alternative is allowed in this test.
entry_exit_rule.cost_model: Subtract 0.16 percentage points round-trip cost from stock return before CSI1000 excess calculation.
entry_exit_rule.unbuyable_entry_handling: If T+1 open is at or near up-limit under existing stk_limit or board fallback logic, skip that row and record pending_no_entry_limit_up; do not replace it with another row.

benchmark_rule.benchmark_return_rule: Compute CSI1000 return from the benchmark T+1 entry date open to the same T+5 exit date close; missing benchmark open/close windows fail the affected row instead of zero-filling. SR-DATA-003 must be resolved before any nonzero-event outcome / excess calculation.

criteria.failure_action: Treat the result as underpowered and do not compute outcome / benchmark excess for this preregistration.
Falsify this redesigned minimal-data burst trigger.
Do not continue this trigger as an alpha candidate; at most record it as exploratory.
Treat drawdown behavior as failing the burst research continuation gate.
Treat A-share limit-risk feasibility as failing the burst research continuation gate.
Treat the result as month-clustered and non-robust.

test_budget.test_budget_consumption_rule: Running even the pre-outcome event-count preflight for this redesigned full-universe trigger consumes one promotion-relevant planned test under the singleton ledger. Changing thresholds, universe, benchmark, holding period, ranking cap, cost model, or pass/fail criteria requires another ledger append and reviewed preregistration.
disallowed_without_ledger: Running this redesigned test before Claude review authorizes the planned ledger item.
Changing from all-pass conjunction to a score or weighted rank.
Adding catalyst, capital-flow, sector, concept, manual evidence, or full-data burst fields.

evidence_integrity_plan.multiple_testing_notes: This artifact is the first ledger-gated redesigned A-share minimal-data burst test after the zero-event corrected-basis preflight. It allows one frozen full-universe trigger only. Any further universe, threshold, ranking, benchmark, holding-period, or trigger-family change must be appended to the singleton program ledger before it runs.

ledger_allowed_locations_if_triggered: independent singleton research test-budget ledger artifact
trigger_events: This artifact changes the universe from steady Tier1 candidates.csv to the frozen full EGS intermediate surface.
This artifact changes the eligibility rule by no longer requiring steady-lane Tier1, entry_flag, chasing_high veto, or overheat veto.
This artifact also tightens the relative_strength signal from the corrected-basis pct_5d >= 6.0 only condition to pct_5d >= 6.0 and pct_20d > market_med_20d.
Any additional change to relative-strength, volume-expansion, breakout, rank-cap, cost, benchmark, or holding-period settings after this preregistration.

next_steps: Do not run this redesigned preregistration until Claude review passes and the ledger planned test is reviewed.
The first executable step, after review, is a pre-outcome event-count / input-integrity preflight only.
Do not compute outcome returns or benchmark excess unless the preflight reaches valid_signal_events >= 30.
Resolve SR-DATA-003 benchmark-open input before any nonzero-event outcome / excess calculation.

If this redesigned test passes, register and run a separate confirmation path before any production promotion: at minimum 2026+ held-out / forward cohorts or 12 months live-normalized forward evidence under the unchanged redesigned trigger.
limitations: This is a ledger-gated redesign because it changes the universe and eligibility controls after the corrected-basis zero-event preflight.
It is minimal-data EOD research, not full-data burst evidence.
It does not use dated catalysts, filings, capital-flow, options, borrow, or manual confirmation evidence.
It is in-sample research over existing generated cohorts and cannot count as live-normalized or ship-gate evidence.
It does not authorize provider access, data fetch, runner changes, production strategy changes, minimal live observation, or full-size manual use.
It does not prove that burst alpha exists; it only registers one frozen redesigned test so that a later reviewed preflight / outcome run cannot silently fish.
